turns.question: How many site sessions were there per order placed between 20 September and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no sessions-per-order metric, so I did not compute one; the closest metrics are Site sessions (7 sessions) and Orders (75 orders) over 20 September to 2 October 2026, both on the day of the event or order. Late: customer_actions.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
